description: This file is a server-rendered HTML template using Jinja2 syntax, used in an LMS web application to display different types of learning content such as videos, articles, and quizzes. It includes blocks for header, content, scripts, and styles, as well as macros to generate different content sections.

methods.name: create_quiz
methods.description: Initializes and embeds the quiz component on the page, configuring its behavior and next steps.

methods.name: get_duration
methods.description: Converts seconds into a HH:MM:SS formatted string.

methods.name: append_zero
methods.description: Ensures a time component is two digits by prefixing a zero if less than 10.
